strategy.gamePlan: The cheapest real deck in the format. Every monster is a vanilla body that beats what the opponent normal summons, and Ancient Rules turns a dead high-level card into a free 3000. You have no card advantage engine, so the plan is to be ahead on board from turn one and never give it back.
openingPriorities: Lead with the 1900s, not Alexandrite Dragon. Keep the 2000 body for the turn it can actually run something over.
Ancient Rules is only good with Blue-Eyes in hand — mulligan your line around drawing the pair, not either half.
Do not attack into an untouched backrow with your only monster when you are ahead on life.
keyInteractions: Mirror Wall halves an attacker permanently and costs half your life each turn it stays. Let it go once it has done its job.
Powerful Rebirth brings back a Level 4 or lower Normal monster with a small stat boost, which is often exactly lethal.
Two Level 4 bodies make Number 39: Utopia, your only answer to a monster bigger than 2000.

matchups.notes: They answer each body one at a time and you never draw a second wave. Push before the traps land.
You cannot touch backrow and they burn faster than you swing. This is the matchup that keeps the deck honest.
They summon two bodies to your one every turn. You need Utopia on board early.
